body: a moss-reclaimed mecha-gorilla forest mount, full clean side-profile reference view, standing on all four limbs (knuckle-walking stance) facing left, all four limbs clearly separated and distinct, an empty rider howdah-seat mounted on the upper back between the shoulders (no rider), a heavy armored head and brow with one visible glowing lens-eye. Deep pine #1f3d2e base plating almost entirely overtaken by real moss and small ferns growing directly out of the panel seams, aged copper #6b7a5c joint fittings patinated green, thin glow-moss emerald #00ff9c veins running under the moss like bioluminescent roots (not painted-on circuit lines -- these should read as living plant matter that happens to glow). TURTLE'S NOTE: the machine should look genuinely reclaimed, not designed-to-look-mossy -- asymmetric moss coverage, thicker on the back and shoulders where rain collects, bare metal showing through on the high-wear knuckles and undersides. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, dappled canopy-filtered forest light, plain flat neutral-green background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible head to tail with all four limbs visible, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
